criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Slides 1, 2, 8 and 6 strong. Slide 5 is a flat tan stack with an unlit blue smear for a mark, slide 4's arm is still boxes and cylinders near the dek, slide 7's panel edge runs through the footer, slide 9 leaves dead black above the bar, slide 1's copper is a smooth gradient with a hard seam.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One bench, one dark register, one key, one motif with the bluebonnet mark recurring. The navy interiors alternate with the black reliefs.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traced, all sources primary, goals labelled, universals attributed, the co-funding implication removed. Looser than source: slide 6 places the platform at TEES where c21 says at Texas A&M; slide 9's 'gets tested' rests on claims not on that frame; the c17 quote is truncated at a comma; the caption's closing question presupposes no alloy yet; slide 7's pool can read as elapsed months.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What and who are clear and the lack of a deadline is honest. No place below Texas A&M, slide 9's actions have no route, the stake stays general.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: A real hook, frame 2 pays, the turn on 4, a close that echoes the cover. Slides 6 and 7 detour and 7 could go.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean and measured with no house rule breaks, little Texas texture.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: A fresh topic and subject. Money counted in wells repeats no. 63 in the same staged dark world.

one_sentence_fix: Make slide 9 live up to its kicker with a place and a route from the fetched pages, and cite c8 or c22 on it so 'the metal still gets tested' rests on a claim.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: An unlit blue smear for the mark, a tan stack on a featureless floor.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: A thin paint pen stroke that takes the key's specular, sheet edges facing the window with a dark cast running right.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A toy arm of boxes and cylinders within about 30 px of the dek.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Drop the camera or arm so the gripper sits at hearth height, tapered cast links.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The panel edge runs through the footer, the pool reads as months elapsed.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: End the panel above the footer band, centre the pool.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: About 250 px of dead black above the bar, the break low.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Raise and scale the bar about 1.2 times so the break sits under the dek.
